crossRefs.note: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent…
But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were…

translations.web: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
translations.bsb: “Do you not know what they are?” replied the angel. “No, my lord,” I answered.
translations.kjv: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
translations.asv: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these are? And I said, No, my lord.
